ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are three curved isolines arranged up and down and roughly parallel, with the right side labeled from top to bottom as c, b, a. The stem gives a>b>C (that is, the value of the lower isobaric surface is the largest, and that of the upper one is the smallest). On the left side of the figure there is a dashed line, with p marked near the upper end and q marked at the near-ground position at the lower end; in this area the three isobaric surfaces as a whole arch upward. On the right side there is a dashed line, with m marked near the upper end and n marked at the near-ground position at the lower end; in this area the three isobaric surfaces as a whole concave downward. Then reason: If these curves represent isobaric surfaces in the vertical direction near the ground, then in an area where the isobaric surfaces arch upward, the air pressure at the same near-ground height is relatively high; in an area where the isobaric surfaces concave downward, the air pressure at the same near-ground height is relatively low. In a near-ground high-pressure area, air mainly undergoes descending motion, clouds and rain are not easily formed, and the weather is relatively clear. In the figure, the upward arching of the isobaric surfaces corresponds to the near-ground position q, so the position with clear weather is q.

<image1>

If the curves in the figure are the distribution of isobaric surfaces in the vertical direction near the ground, and a>b>C, which position in the figure corresponds to clear weather near the ground?

method.method_draft: 先读图：三条曲线是垂直方向的等压面，右侧标注从上到下为c、b、a；题干给出a>b>c，说明越往下等压面数值越大。图中左侧虚线附近的等压面整体向上拱起，近地面位置为q；右侧虚线附近的等压面整体向下凹，近地面位置为n。推理时在同一近地面高度比较气压：等压面向上拱起处，同一高度距离较高数值等压面更远地位于其下方，表示近地面气压偏高；等压面下凹处表示近地面气压偏低。近地面高压区盛行下沉气流，云雨少，天气晴朗，所以对应位置为q。

再推理：若这些曲线表示近地面垂直方向等压面，则等压面向上拱起的地区，同一近地面高度上气压偏高；等压面向下凹的地区，同一近地面高度上气压偏低。近地面高压区空气以下沉运动为主，不易形成云雨，天气较晴朗。图中等压面上拱对应近地面位置 q，所以天气晴朗的位置是 q。
